'''Knarlwood''' was a type of wood. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Nestin Thokor]] had a desk made from polished knarlwood inside his office, in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Oluna Biqua]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]].
